lines.en: label harukasummer2nightgen:
scene harukasummer2nightgen
I give Haruka a call and wind up catching a bus ride over to her neighborhood so the two of us can get dinner at some hole-in-the-wall Chinese restaurant she frequents.
lines.zh: 我给 Haruka 打了电话，最后搭公交车去了她住的那片，好让我俩去一家她常去的破旧中餐馆吃晚饭。

lines.en: I ask her about how long she’s been coming here and she goes silent for a moment, not quite knowing how to respond. Which, in itself, is more of a response than I bargained for in the first place.
lines.zh: 我问她来这儿多久了，她沉默了片刻，不太知道该怎么回答。而这沉默本身，就已经比我预想得到的回应多得多。

lines.en: I’m sure I’m not the first person to take a seat beside her in there.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，我不是第一个在她身边坐下的人。

lines.en: I’m sure I’m not the first person to comment on the sun-bleached menus stuck to the storefront windows and how it looks like the place hasn’t been cleaned in years.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，也不是第一个对橱窗上晒褪了色的菜单、对这家看起来好几年没打扫过的地方评头论足的人。

lines.en: But I’m sure I’m the first person who’s done any of those things ever since her husband left.
lines.zh: 但我敢肯定，自她丈夫离开之后，我是第一个做这些事的人。

lines.en: She knows that. And she knows {i}I{/i} know that- which is why she takes it upon herself to come out and assure me that I am not just a replacement.
lines.zh: 她知道。她也知道{i}我{/i}知道——所以她主动开口向我保证，我不只是个替代品。

lines.en: That I am not just someone to block the wind from the rotating fan beside the table we ate at.
lines.zh: 我不只是个替我们吃饭那张桌子旁的电风扇挡风的人。

lines.en: scene black
Haruka disappears into the bathroom for ten minutes and comes back with her eyes slightly swollen and red.
lines.zh: Haruka 去了趟洗手间，十分钟后回来，眼睛微微肿着、发红。

lines.en: She pays the cashier before I have time to comment on them and urges me outside, hoping that the darkness is enough to hide her misery when we all know it’s not.
lines.zh: 我还没来得及说什么，她就先付了钱，催我出去，指望夜色能遮住她的难过——可我们都心知肚明，那根本遮不住。

lines.en: I ignore it, though. That’s just the type of person I am.
lines.zh: 不过我假装没看见。我就是这种人。

lines.en: For if she wants to pretend to be happy, I will too.
lines.zh: 因为如果她想装作开心，那我也陪她一起装。

lines.en: And I will accompany her into any hole in any wall that she’s afraid to enter alone.
lines.zh: 而她不敢独自走进的任何墙缝里的任何小洞，我都会陪她进去。
